en-US.description: Your AI agent for subtitles & video
en-US.longDescription: Tell the agent what you want, or do it by hand. BaoCut 2 transcribes on your computer, translates subtitles that fit the screen, and dubs your video into another language in the speaker’s own voice.
en-US.name: BaoCut (Vulkan)
en-US.releaseNotes:
BaoCut 3.19.0 (build 95)
Captions
- Preserve sentence and paragraph boundaries when a transcription gives a sentence-initial word zero duration. Caption ranges and subsequent transcript edits keep the carried word in both generated captions and the editor. (source)
Command line
- When a port is already in use, services start, web open and web review explain how to configure another port and restart the service. The remedy is available in every supported CLI language. (service startup, web commands)
Production scripts and virtual hosts
- Add host.mjs to join consecutive host segments into one motion track and character sticker, keeping head and hair movement continuous between segments. Reruns skip unchanged groups, preserve placement for motion-only changes, and replace groups whose timeline span changed. (source)
- Remove stale fragments left when a managed host sticker was split in the editor. The host script manages stickers using its character package on its dedicated host track; place unrelated stickers on another track. (source)
- Add frames.mjs for composited contact sheets with captions, text, stickers, hosts and live code scenes; segment first/last-frame checks; and freeze detection with optional region selection. It requires ffmpeg and reports candidates for human review. (source)
- Allow voice.bc and asr.bc to use separate CLI commands and Runtime credentials. Alignment reports suspect letter/digit words with timestamps and what was recognized; font warnings distinguish newly added characters requiring a regenerated subset from glyphs the font does not contain. (source)
- Update guidance for reserving space around virtual hosts, rerunning host placement after assembly, using DOM canvases for offscreen baking, and compositing translucent tiled shapes once to avoid darker overlaps. (source)
Requirements and verification limits
- macOS: Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later; signed and notarized packages are published after native validation.
- Windows: unsigned packages; AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable are required. CUDA/Vulkan variants require compatible GPU drivers.
- ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies.
- Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
Source coverage
Changes since 3.18.0 build 94, 9 commits, 0 associated PRs, reviewed in one batch with complete source coverage. Prior-release feed/Homebrew updates and their merge are included in the source inventory and omitted from feature highlights. The release preparation commit only updates package versions and these notes.
Full comparison
Platform verification
BaoCut 3.19.0 (Build 95) for Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.
Bundle ID: com.baocut.app. Developer ID signed, hardened runtime and Apple notarization accepted for both App and DMG.
Runtime and native Worker startup, signer fingerprint, staple and Gatekeeper checks passed. UI/export, real model inference and paid Agent calls were not exercised by this workflow. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine are external dependencies.
Source: bc759a4d564694c2626dbf9089218d7d6f04ef90
Actions: https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/actions/runs/42863812738
Windows x64
Variants: cpu, cuda, vulkan. NSIS installers and portable ZIPs, and the standalone command line ZIPs (BaoCut-CLI-…), are unsigned. Real credential migration and model/Agent/GPU inference were not exercised by the installer tests. Requires the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; the current package does not bundle the VC runtime DLLs.
Native build and installer verification: https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/actions/runs/42863812738
